# 寶樓閣經梵字真言

**ID:** T1005B
**Volume:** T19
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Date:** 805
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1005B

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Siddhaṃ-Chinese parallel reference text giving the principal mantras of the *Vipula-prāsāda* sūtra in their original Sanskrit script alongside the Chinese transliterations. The text is the *fànběn* 梵本 / *fànzì* 梵字 ("Sanskrit-script") liturgical-reference companion to the canonical Amoghavajra translation T1005A ([KR6j0197](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0197)).

**Abstract**

The *fànzì* genre — preserving the Sanskrit-Siddhaṃ original of the canonical mantras — was central to the Tang Esoteric mantra-instruction pedagogy and especially to the Japanese Shingon Sanskrit-script tradition. The text supplements the Amoghavajra T1005A ([KR6j0197](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0197)) translation by providing the Sanskrit-script reference that allowed practitioners to recite the mantras with their original phonetic accuracy. The compilation is anonymous and was likely produced as a study-aid in the late-Tang or early-Sòng Esoteric ritual tradition. The format mirrors that of the parallel T974E ([KR6j0156](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0156)) for the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya* and T983B ([KR6j0170](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0170)) for the *Mahāmāyūrī*.
